descriptions.w3d_trail_owner_vector_800cd0d0: Returns an owner vector or the shared default vector when the owner handle cannot be resolved.
descriptions.w3d_trail_owner_float_800cd13c: Returns an owner float value or the default constant when the owner handle cannot be resolved.
